thread:
oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] p99 queue depth spike on runtime-eu-west-1 (svc: embeddings-v2). Alert 1718202245. Auto-created incident: https://redwood/incidents/INC-2026-042
alex: Ack, I'm oncall. Seeing sustained queue length ~120 per shard, token p99 latency ~600ms, some client timeouts reported.
priya: Confirmed. Telemetry shows a surge from tenant 'playground' and a batch of long-sequence requests. Hot path looks like the reranker step loading large KV slices.
maria: Quick idea: can we temporarily disable the model reranker for non-enterprise tenants? That's the heaviest compute op right now.
alex: Mitigation plan: 1) Reduce max_inflight for embeddings-v2 from 200 -> 80 to force shedding of low-priority work. 2) Toggle reranker feature off for non-enterprise. 3) Bump enterprise per-tenant quota so paid customers stay healthy. Also consider increasing request timeout to avoid mid-flight aborts.
ryan: Executing change 1: POST /admin/runtime/config {"service":"embeddings-v2","max_inflight":80} (rolling to eu-west-1).
ops-bot: Config change accepted, deploying to runtime cluster eu-west-1. Rollout: 0% -> 40% -> 100% (45s).
alex: Change 1 complete. Queue depth dropping to ~30 per shard, p99 down to ~220ms.
priya: Toggling reranker flag for non-enterprise: `ff toggle reranker_enabled --scope non-enterprise --off`
ops-bot: Feature flag updated: reranker_enabled=false (scope: non-enterprise).
maria: Reranker off is in. GPU utilization down ~18%, throughput increased. Search quality for some playground queries degrades ~5% — flagging for CS.
customer-success: Thanks — we'll draft a short note to top impacted accounts (playground/test orgs). Keep us updated if you expect any user-facing changes.
ryan: Also rolling timeout bump: `PATCH /admin/runtime/config {"service":"embeddings-v2","request_timeout_s":45}` to reduce abort churn. Deploy started.
alex: Monitoring: inflight errors decreasing, overall latency stabilizing. If the load comes back we should be ready to tighten `max_inflight` further or enable tenant-based shedding rules.
priya: I'll prepare rollback commands in case quality impact is unacceptable: revert max_inflight -> 200 and flip reranker back on.
maria: Post-incident tasks: collect traces for top 50 slow requests, run A/B eval on search quality with reranker off, and document tenant thresholds that triggered shedding.
alex: Handoff: @ryan you own the watch for the next 30m. If stable, hand to @priya for the next shift. If latency creeps above 400ms p99, revert changes immediately.
ryan: ACK. I'll annotate the incident ticket with the mitigation steps and timeline.
priya: ACK takeover plan noted. Will coordinate a brief customer update and a postmortem doc.
alex: Update: 30m after mitigations, system stable and customer-visible errors reduced to baseline. Creating incident summary and scheduling postmortem.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 marked as mitigated at 1718202575."
